posts.content_md:
The question was prompted by this thread.

[http://holographyforum.org/phpBB2/viewt ... 2555#32555](http://holographyforum.org/phpBB2/viewtopic.php?p=32555#32555)

Do any of you have any recommendations for an electonic scale that would be:

o Cheap.

o Reasonably accurate. Accurate to within 1/2 gram maybe?

o Sturdy.

Do you have something that didn't cost and arm and a leg and is still working correctly after many years of service and is still available on the market (or you're willing to sell)?

posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
Yes, I bought a digital postal scale that weighs in onces and grams (1 gram intervals). For my gelatin this is fine as I slowly add unitil the scale just hits the weight I want. I have never calibrated it. For the AmDi I use a 4 gram ballance (plastic).

Large one is something very similar to this - [http://www.overcost.com/cat.asp?c=7&n=M ... froogle_fd](http://www.overcost.com/cat.asp?c=7&n=Mailroom+%26+Packing+Materials&s=191&sn=Equipment&ss=385&ssn=Postal+Scales&g=1084&gn=Straight+Weigh+Metric+Digital+Postal+Scale&referer=froogle_fd)

Small one is almost exactly like this - [http://scientificsonline.com/product.as ... 1126898180](http://scientificsonline.com/product.asp?pn=3036028roogle&bhcd2=1126898180)
